in_marathi.name: Bhagban
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessed by God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagban हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is blessed by God and has divine protection. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhagati’ which means to obtain or possess something through devotion and dedication. The name Bhagban is often given to a child born in a religious family or to one who is expected to lead a pious life.
